headline: LADbible says a viral video of an oddly shaped man dancing in a bar is AI-made, and the account behind it has gained over 90,000 followers in days.
score_reason: Pool score 1 kept: a viral oddity from one outlet, no lasting consequence shown.
importance_line: Ordinary social media users are the ones fooled or flooded by fake AI characters, and platforms face a growing pile of such accounts, but LADbible shows no proof that this account is selling anything.
summary: LADbible reports that a viral bar-dance video posted by an account called Benjamin Stachio, which is only a few days old but has over 90,000 followers, is AI-made. LADbible says it looks like part of a trend of fake AI characters used to build a following, with some such accounts later pushing meme-coins (joke cryptocurrencies), though this account's profile says it has 'no crypto affiliation yet'.
notes: Read from the pre-fetched LADbible page.
